scope: Every exposed route/control must still be enumerated under SCOPE-01; this feature-family map does not certify every category/language/provider. Data/API names are targets unless explicitly connected. The founder-spec reconciliation preserves current journeys and a deterministic teaching runtime.

sharedLayers.frontend: Preserve the current route/facade, accessibility and released locale/category/role behavior. Runtime-validate DTOs; show loading/empty/partial/denied/revoked/conflict/unavailable/retry honestly and preserve recoverable drafts.
sharedLayers.api: Versioned command/query schema, bounded JSON/files, errors/cursors and timeout; stable mutation ID plus payload digest; conditional revision; no automatic retry with a new command ID after ambiguous commit.
sharedLayers.authority: Verified Firebase UID/session/device, expected account and mutation Origin/CSRF; server-derived workspace membership, purpose/consent/source policy. IDs and events locate data but never grant permission.
sharedLayers.database: One authoritative store per invariant. Firestore owns account/billing; PostgreSQL owns domain/membership/evidence/run state, linked by the same UID. Private objects hold bytes. Cross-store effects use durable idempotent reconciliation, not an assumed distributed transaction.
sharedLayers.jobs: When asynchronous: owning-store outbox, private task identity, leases/fencing, bounded retries/deadline, cancellation, restart/ack recovery and exactly one accepted completion. Mark no-job operations explicitly; never add queues just for a diagram.
sharedLayers.cache: Default to no shared private-response cache. If enabled: UID/workspace/policy/resource/source/model/locale versioned key as applicable, bounded entries, reauthorization/invalidation and cache-down fallback. CDN only for approved public assets. Cache expiry is not permission or a record-retention policy.
sharedLayers.realtime: HTTPS commands remain authoritative. Durable ordered change/run events are observations; bounded polling baseline and SSE where required. Define auth/connect/reconnect/output checks, heartbeat/backoff/backpressure, duplicate/gap/cursor-expiry handling, refetch and two-device convergence. WebSocket requires reviewed bidirectional need; current browser storage events are local only.
sharedLayers.ml: Only explicitly allowed tasks call the private model/tool adapter. Pin input/source/prompt/model/tool versions, bounded usage and scoped memory; validate output/citations/outcomes and recheck permission before delivery/acceptance. No ML involvement is a valid explicit choice.
sharedLayers.entitlements: Server checks current feature entitlement and fleet/UID/workspace admission before expensive work. Unique usage reservation/ledger/settlement; plans/Family benefits never confer educational or organization authority.
sharedLayers.operations: Per-feature redacted correlation traces, latency/error/queue/unit-cost metrics, quota limits and failure diagnosis; schema/config compatibility, backups/restore, canary/rollback and named launch acceptance. No raw private prompt/payment context in routine telemetry.
sharedLayers.acceptance: Meaningful UI→real API→authoritative store→read/resume tests; two devices where state persists, wrong actor/workspace/source/consent denial, concurrency/idempotency, disconnect/restart and dependency outages. Attach exact change, environment, tests/results and rollout evidence; local fixtures cannot close hosted/provider gates.

features.name: Public discovery and purchase entry
features.api: Public approved catalog/static content; existing /api/billing/catalog. Purchase saves safe intent, then verified auth/onboarding and authenticated checkout. Inventory contact/community/referral/download controls; connect their reviewed service or label unavailable.
features.database: Approved public publication/catalog projections; no public access to account/profile/payment records. Submitted support data uses its separate authorized purpose.
features.jobs: Only actual approved support/communication submissions enqueue work; passive page navigation has no job.
features.cache: Public hashed assets CDN; revalidate HTML/catalog revisions. Never cache personalized checkout or auth return publicly.
features.realtime: No public socket. Refetch approved catalog; continue purchase through account/billing status.
features.ml: No model call required for browsing/pricing or purchase authority.
features.outcome: Every exposed public control has a truthful destination/state; signed-out purchase resumes once after sign-in and never charges twice.

features.name: Identity, onboarding, profile and devices
features.api: Connected /api/auth/** and /api/account/** controllers retain compatibility; provider verification/reset matrix and SQL personal-workspace provisioning are additional acceptance.
features.database: Firestore visionary_accounts/{uid} and device/session records; minimal SQL persons(uid)/provisioning linkage. Same UID on every device; role preference never creates membership.
features.jobs: Cross-store provisioning/recovery and approved delivery only; session verification stays on its authoritative request path.
features.cache: No shared auth/profile cache; clear account-scoped queries on logout/switch/revocation.
features.realtime: Refetch session/account/device state after focus/reconnect. Durable account change observation must not replace session validity checks.
features.ml: No model authenticates a person or decides admission.
features.outcome: Provider return, expiry, account switch, interrupted onboarding/provisioning and revoked device recover safely on a second device.

features.name: Connections, consent and workspace switching
features.api: Target workspace list/activation, invitation accept/revoke and explicit purpose/consent commands with actor/policy/revision checks.
features.database: SQL persons, workspaces, memberships, consent_grants/share_grants, command_results/audit/outbox. Current selected workspace is per device, not a global permission.
features.jobs: Invitation/delivery and revocation propagation through durable outbox; verify policy at worker completion.
features.cache: Partition by UID/workspace/policy; permission withdrawal invalidates pending/cache-derived access.
features.realtime: Membership/consent change hints trigger authorized refetch; device A switching workspace must not switch device B.
features.ml: Supplies only permitted context; private memory never crosses workspaces by selection alone.
features.outcome: Pending/expired/revoked invitations, concurrent role changes and in-flight output are denied consistently across devices.

features.name: Catalog, curriculum and source publication
features.api: Target eligible catalog/concept/source-version queries; upload→scan→review→publish/withdraw commands. Preserve content.syllabus/content.concept facade operations.
features.database: SQL source_versions/publications/content_nodes and immutable manifests; private GCS generations; approved released-language/source pointers.
features.jobs: Private bounded scan/parse/chunk/embed/evaluate with provenance and atomic publication pointers.
features.cache: Only permission-filtered source/release/version/locale cache; withdraw stops new retrieval and pending delivery.
features.realtime: Publication/withdrawal revision changes refetch eligible catalog; progress/status events never publish incomplete sources.
features.ml: Approved ingestion/retrieval only; evaluate released category/language segmentation and citation offsets.
features.outcome: No unreviewed/withdrawn/private source appears in search, citations, model context, downloads or second-device catalog.

features.name: Learning sessions and resume
features.api: Target owned learning session/checkpoint/resume commands and source-pinned concept queries behind existing facades.
features.database: SQL owned session/checkpoint/source revision and command outcomes; local originals retained until reviewed migration.
features.jobs: Checkpoint save is transactional; derived projections use outbox if asynchronous.
features.cache: UID/workspace/source/session revision keys; separate unsaved draft from committed checkpoint.
features.realtime: Authorized cursor/refetch, independent per-device navigation, concurrent checkpoint conflict and offline recovery.
features.ml: Authored learning works without generation; any assistance follows Ask/Guide gates.
features.outcome: Concept→check/practice→private project→save→second-device resume; no lost original draft or false saved state.

features.name: Visionary Ask and grounded assistance
features.api: Target teaching-runs/conversation commands mapping teaching.request; bounded synchronous teaching deadline and explicit partial/final/error schema.
features.database: SQL conversations/ai_runs/turns, source manifest, usage reservation/ledger and immutable candidate/result evidence.
features.jobs: Bounded request cancellation; durable long work uses run/outbox protocol instead of extending teaching timeout.
features.cache: AI-05 scoped cache remains off until isolation proof; never a global query→answer cache.
features.realtime: SSE only for authorized partial observation with truthful final validation; reconnect uses persisted run/snapshot; no success on validator failure.
features.ml: Permitted retrieval, model adapter, bounded tools, grounding/schema/citation checks and explicit unknown/unavailable. The imported NLI client repair is locally tested; gateway streaming, cache and authority integration remain unaccepted.
features.outcome: Useful source-correct answer on released tasks; abstention/recovery, wrong-source denial, bounded cost and no cross-conversation access.

features.name: Guide, planning and permitted memory
features.api: Target mentor-turns/plans/allowed-action proposals mapping mentor.turn; current Guide is an embedded UI, not an invented /dashboard/guide route.
features.database: Owned conversations/goals/plans and approved-purpose memory with evidence/provenance/version; separate personal/company/guardian context.
features.jobs: Durable plan/tool checkpoints when needed; explicit pause/resume and stop rules. No autonomous submission/grade/payment.
features.cache: No unscoped personal-memory cache; current policy and memory preference checked on each use.
features.realtime: Plan/run changes refetch; old-context actions rejected after device workspace/account change.
features.ml: Evaluate planning/replanning, permitted recall, explanation and transfer; generated memory/plan stays provisional until permitted acceptance.
features.outcome: User can understand and accept the next step, correct a plan and resume without leaked memory or invented assessed progress.

features.name: Checks, practice and assessed evidence
features.api: Target owned attempt/answer/complete with immutable criteria/source version, stable mutation key and protected answer keys.
features.database: SQL attempts/evidence_events and versioned rubric/feedback; client pass/completed flags never create trusted evidence.
features.jobs: Authoritative scoring/check commit; optional reviewed remediation outside the scoring authority.
features.cache: Never place answer keys or other learner attempts in public/shared payloads; version derived evidence queries.
features.realtime: Attempt/evidence revision observation with deduplicated submit and stale-score rejection.
features.ml: Hints/remediation are candidates; measured reasoning and teacher-reviewed rubrics qualify any model-assisted assessment.
features.outcome: Duplicate/late answers, forged scores, changed rubric and interrupted completion cannot award incorrect mastery or guided eligibility.

features.name: Home, progress, goals and discovery
features.api: Target owned progress/home/due-review/goal commands with understandable recommendation reasons.
features.database: Versioned projections from immutable evidence; plans/preferences distinct from assessed results; bounded owner/period queries.
features.jobs: Idempotent projection/rebuild and review scheduling, never overwriting source evidence.
features.cache: Revisioned owner/workspace/projection keys; mark stale/rebuilding states and refetch from evidence-backed authority.
features.realtime: Evidence changes invalidate exact projection scopes; offline/stale results cannot overwrite newer progress.
features.ml: Evaluated recommendations may propose steps; model confidence, media consumption and self-review remain distinct from mastery.
features.outcome: Progress is reproducible from accepted evidence and consistent after retry/rebuild/two-device resume.

features.name: Build, private projects and reviewed proposals
features.api: Target project/revision/draft/run/proposal accept/reject/share/export contracts from Build DATA_AND_CONTRACTS. Mutations stay HTTPS and bind base revision.
features.database: Target build_projects/revisions/briefs/runs/proposals/events/share_grants/usage/outbox, immutable private object manifests. DATA-01 resolves final DDL names before migration.
features.jobs: Durable run/lease/fence/checkpoint/cancel/restart; bounded isolated export. Arbitrary execution/app previews/deployment remain later gates.
features.cache: Separate per-tab original-base drafts from immutable committed revision and run snapshots; stale proposals cannot update head.
features.realtime: Authorized run sequence via polling/SSE; bounded stdout, gap recovery, cursor expiry and persisted terminal state. A stream does not save/accept a proposal.
features.ml: Bounded generation/critique/tools on permitted context; exact-revision proposal needs user acceptance. No automatic share/submit/deploy/mastery.
features.outcome: Create→save→run→review→conditional accept→export/share exact revision→resume on second device, with cancellation/conflict/revocation failure cases.

features.name: Teacher preparation, classes and submissions
features.api: Target verified class/enrollment/assignment publish/schedule/submit/review/return/request-revision commands; fixed assignment and submission copy.
features.database: SQL class/enrollment/assignment_versions/submissions/feedback_revisions, retained immutable attempts and audit; no email/role picker authority.
features.jobs: Approved schedule/delivery/projection via outbox with timezone/idempotency; submit/review uses authoritative transaction.
features.cache: Teacher only sees permitted submitted copies/fields; private learner drafts/chat excluded; invalidate enrollment/review revisions.
features.realtime: Assignment/submission/return status refetch; scoped events on revocation and teacher/learner reconnect.
features.ml: Reviewed preparation/feedback candidates; server/human assessment owns released grade and action authority.
features.outcome: Teacher publish→learner submit→teacher review/return→learner revision with preserved history and wrong-class denial.

features.name: Guardian relationships and summaries
features.api: Target verified guardian-link and purpose/period/field-scoped fixed-summary/goal/digest operations.
features.database: SQL relationship/consent/share grants and fixed report snapshots with expiry/revocation evidence; billing Family is separate.
features.jobs: Only approved digest/summary generation; reauthorize recipient and purpose at delivery.
features.cache: No child chat/draft cache access; purpose/period/policy scoped summary and immediate future-access withdrawal.
features.realtime: Grant expiry/revocation closes observation and refetches allowed summaries; reconsent does not revive an old share.
features.ml: Guidance only from the allowed summary, never hidden child conversation/private history.
features.outcome: Verified guardian sees only explicitly shared fields; expiry/revocation and Family payer status cannot bypass consent.

features.name: Career, personal/company boundaries and portfolios
features.api: Target career goals/self-review/company membership and exact-revision portfolio-share commands.
features.database: SQL personal/company memberships, private goals, versioned self-review and explicit share grants; no implicit employer ownership.
features.jobs: Reviewed share/delivery/report jobs with current consent and exact revision.
features.cache: Personal/company query and memory namespaces remain distinct; employer withdrawal invalidates only agreed access.
features.realtime: Per-device context and owned portfolio/share revisions; reject stale company/personal responses.
features.ml: Evidence-grounded skill/project guidance; self-review is not a credential or assessed mastery.
features.outcome: Personal work remains private through joining/leaving employer, sharing/revoking portfolio and second-device resume.

features.name: Organization people, curriculum, analytics and audit
features.api: Target least-privilege organization invitations/roles/cohorts/publication/settings/aggregate/audit commands and paginated queries.
features.database: SQL organization memberships/publications/suppressed aggregate/report snapshots/audit; final schema reviewed under DATA-01.
features.jobs: Bounded publication/projection/delivery with policy/version checks and aggregate suppression.
features.cache: Organization/policy/release scoped projections; never leak small-group/private student records via aggregates.
features.realtime: Role/publication/report revision hints and authorized refetch; withdraw stops pending output.
features.ml: Only approved-source/aggregate assistance under scoped policy; no unrestricted administrator learner dump.
features.outcome: Publish/withdraw and role changes propagate correctly; private personal learning/grades remain outside unauthorized organizational access.

features.name: Plans, subscription, entitlement and invoices
features.api: Connected /api/billing/** and payer account invoice APIs; test checkout/verify/sync/cancel/raw signed webhook contracts retained. Hosted/live acceptance separate.
features.database: UID Firestore billing commands/subscription/provider events/immutable payer invoices; unique usage ledger ties request/workspace to current payer/entitlement without duplicating authority in SQL.
features.jobs: Per-account test reconciliation/outbox/Tasks and provider-rate-aware retry; no startup/scaling side-effect charges.
features.cache: Payment state/entitlement always authoritative; no public cache of private receipts or inferred paid success from client widget/event.
features.realtime: Authorized billing revision refetch on second device; webhook can be late/reordered, unknown stays pending until reconciled.
features.ml: No model decides payment success, refunds, grants or charges; server usage admission precedes calls.
features.outcome: Auth→Free default→test purchase→verified entitlement→payer-only invoice→second device, duplicate/reordered/refund/cancel and expired-session recovery.

features.name: Notification and communication preferences
features.api: Target authorized inbox pagination/read/preferences and reviewed delivery commands; explicit selected channel/provider acceptance.
features.database: Owned durable inbox/read/preferences and source event/recipient/policy/version dedupe; separate from business state.
features.jobs: Outbox delivery with idempotency/quiet preference/retry and current recipient permission.
features.cache: Owner/workspace/policy/inbox revision and bounded unread projection; no private material in public email links.
features.realtime: Notification hints/refetch with gap recovery; duplicates never execute underlying business action.
features.ml: No model required for notification delivery; any generated message is separately reviewed/minimized.
features.outcome: Read/preference state converges across devices; revoked recipient and failed delivery cannot leak data or lose committed business state.

features.name: Privacy, memory controls and data requests
features.api: Target explicit authorized purpose/preferences/export and separately approved deletion commands, job status/download. Current keep-data/no-purge instruction remains; no deletion is executed by planning.
features.database: UID-scoped job manifests, consent/purpose versions/audit and approved policy/tombstones spanning Firestore/SQL/objects/providers; preserve required historical records.
features.jobs: Reviewed export/deletion saga with bounded resumption/reconciliation; revoke new access first, restore respects current policy.
features.cache: Revocation covers queries/objects/model contexts and derived caches; cache policy never invents a record retention TTL.
features.realtime: Owner-only job progress and terminal artifact refetch; signed URLs have explicit residual validity or authenticated gateway.
features.ml: No automatic private-data training; memory preferences/current rights checked; no raw global quality export.
features.outcome: Only verified owner gets a bounded export; permissions and recovery remain correct across requests/backups; future deletion waits for approved policy/authorization.

features.name: Optional feedback, support and improvement
features.api: Connected POST/GET /api/account/feedback retains strict minimized fields/dedupe; future support operator/triage/export contract is separate.
features.database: Firestore UID feedback/feedbackState/command records; approved support/audit records retain owner/purpose and scoped operator access.
features.jobs: No automatic Jira/private learner-note export or training; reviewed support/triage only with approved purpose.
features.cache: No shared feedback/note cache; ambiguous submission keeps draft and replays original key.
features.realtime: Receipt/history refetch; no socket needed to confirm a feedback commit. Do not interrupt learning/checkout with prompts.
features.ml: Optional reviewed improvement/evaluation loop; negative rating and generated correction are not ground-truth training labels.
features.outcome: Optional short feedback→confirmed one record or recoverable retry; authorized support with no raw-context capture or learner-note leakage.

capabilityChecks.criterion: Novel concept/problem tasks with permitted evidence; independent rubric/teacher correctness review
Multi-step Learn/Build goals, changed constraints, pause/restart and replanning; inspect final saved outcome
Permitted recall and correction under current purpose; negative cross-user/workspace and revocation tests
Typed allowlisted tools, server authority at every step, idempotent side effects and bounded failure recovery
Held-out task families and released languages; feedback correction versus memorization; no training without rights/strategy
Detect unsupported/failed validation, abstain/degrade truthfully, recover without invented success
Perception/generation only for explicitly released voice/image/structured tasks, with device/locale/cost tests
Cross-device durability/authority, latency, cost per completed task and rollback; separate from intelligence score
